$comment: Single source of truth for Flutter CI test shards (ci.yml matrix, ci-full-audit, coverage merge, pre-push). Every active *_test.dart must fall under exactly one shard root — enforced by `node scripts/ci/flutter-shards.mjs check` (governance job). Frozen roots come from docs/engineering/frozen-domains/manifest.json. Paths are relative to flutter_app/. Shards are balanced from measured batched timings (~45-90 s of tests each on a 4-vCPU runner); re-balance when a shard's job exceeds ~2.5 min.
perFileRoots_comment: Roots whose files always run one per `flutter test` process. test/features/auth intermittently segfaults flutter_tester during coverage collection when batched (Flutter 3.44, 2026-09-30) — in batch with other roots and occasionally alone; per-file it is stable (~6 s/file). Other roots run batched; any crash there is caught by the runner's no-progress watchdog + isolated re-run.
